question:
You are helping Youssef, who runs a furniture workshop near Oujda. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The workshop makes doors and beds.
Last year's total revenue was 6,532,000 dollars.
The parking lot has 68 spaces, 5 of them reserved for visitors.
Each of the doors needs 4 units of wood, 3 machine hours, and earns a profit of 53 dollars.
Each of the beds needs 8 units of wood, 6 machine hours, and earns a profit of 45 dollars.
This week the workshop has 52 units of wood and 55 machine hours available.
Delivery trucks usually arrive around 7:45 in the morning.
Everything produced will be sold, and only whole units can be made.
A competitor opened a new site in Kenitra 5 months ago.
How many of each product should be made to maximise total profit?
answer_keys: The maximum total profit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total profit in dollars
independent_check: brute force over every production plan
